camel_example: aliyun aiworkspace POST /api/v1/images --region cn-hangzhou --header "Content-Type=application/json" --body '{"Description":"NLP模型压缩训练镜像","Accessibility":"PUBLIC","Size":2,"UserId":"16110000003000","SourceType":"Build","SourceId":"build-0000ks92","WorkspaceId":"1500000045","ImageId":"image-k8300000cv","Labels":[{"Value":"GPU","Key":"system.chipType"}],"ImageUri":"registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/pai-compression/nlp:gpu","Name":"nlp-compression"}'
description_en: Adds a custom image to a workspace
description_zh: 添加自定义镜像到工作空间
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace add-image --name nlp-compression --description 'NLP模型压缩训练镜像' --image-uri registry.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/pai-compression/nlp:gpu --labels Value=GPU Key=system.chipType --workspace-id 1500000045 --accessibility PUBLIC --size 2 --image-id image-k8300000cv --source-type Build --source-id build-0000ks92 --user-id 16110000003000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddImage

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the image. Valid values:

PUBLIC: All members in the current workspace can manage the image.
PRIVATE: Only the creator can manage the image
parameters.help_zh:
镜像的可见性，目前支持：

PUBLIC：当前工作空间所有成员都可以操作。
PRIVATE：只有创建者可以操作
parameters.name: accessibility

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the image. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically generates an image ID.
The format is image- followed by 18 uppercase or lowercase letters or digits
parameters.help_zh:
镜像Id，如果不填，系统会自动生成。
格式为image-18位大小写英文字母或者数字
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The URI of the image. The URI can be duplicated. For more information about how to view the image URI, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449118.html
parameters.help_zh: 镜像地址，可以重复。关于如何查看镜像地址，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449118.html
parameters.name: image_uri

parameters.help_en:
The labels of the image. This parameter is an array, and each item in the array contains the key and value fields.
Official images have the following label: system.official=true.
The following keys are supported:

system.chipType
system.dsw.cudaVersion
system.dsw.fromImageId
system.dsw.fromInstanceId
system.dsw.id
system.dsw.os
system.dsw.osVersion
system.dsw.resourceType
system.dsw.rootImageId
system.dsw.stage
system.dsw.tag
system.dsw.type
system.framework
system.origin
system.pythonVersion
system.source
system.supported.dlc
system.supported.dsw
parameters.help_zh:
镜像标签，是个数组，数组每一项包含key和value两个字段。
官方镜像有如下标签：system.official=true
目前支持添加的键如下：

system.chipType
system.dsw.cudaVersion
system.dsw.fromImageId
system.dsw.fromInstanceId
system.dsw.id
system.dsw.os
system.dsw.osVersion
system.dsw.resourceType
system.dsw.rootImageId
system.dsw.stage
system.dsw.tag
system.dsw.type
system.framework
system.origin
system.pythonVersion
system.source
system.supported.dlc
system.supported.dsw
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en:
The name of the image. The naming rules are as follows:
The name must be 1 to 50 characters in length.
The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-), and must start with a letter.
The name must be unique within the same workspace
parameters.help_zh:
镜像名称。命名规则如下：
长度为1~50个英文字符。
支持小写字母、数字和短横线（-），以字母开头。
同一工作空间内不可重复
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The size of the image. Unit: GB
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The source ID of the image. If the source type of the image is Build, the source ID is the image build ID
parameters.help_zh: 镜像来源 ID。 当镜像来源类型是“构建”时，来源 ID 对应镜像构建 ID
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.help_en:
The source type of the image. Valid values:
Import: The image is imported.
Build: The image is built
parameters.help_zh:
镜像来源类型：
 Import : 导入
 Build ：构建
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID (UID) of the image creator
parameters.help_zh: 镜像创建者的用户 ID（UID）
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the image belongs. For more information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 镜像所属的工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id
